customManagers.description: Track cloud/setup.sh's cosign pin, which follows todofixthis/config-paddock's COSIGN_VERSION.

dependencyDashboardFooter: Approve a sigstore/cosign bump only after todofixthis/config-paddock's has merged, and merge its PR only at config-paddock's COSIGN_VERSION (see cloud/setup.sh).

packageRules.description: Hold cosign bumps for approval on the Dependency Dashboard: approve only once todofixthis/config-paddock's bump has merged, as cloud/setup.sh's comment requires.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Merge only if this version equals `todofixthis/config-paddock`'s `COSIGN_VERSION`; Renovate offers the newest release, which config-paddock may not have tested yet.

⚠️ Sessions keep the old cosign until the ~7-day setup cache rebuild. To apply it sooner, bump `cloud/pointer.sh`'s version comment in a follow-up PR after merging, then re-paste it into the environment's Setup script field (README.md, "Making changes").
